rationale.root:host.source-inventory:8:0: The shared Path-based source walker owns discovery. Preserve OS Path traversal and supported-extension policy; reject opaque directory labels explicitly, and propagate actual read_dir iterator errors instead of silently presenting incomplete inventory.
rationale.root:host.source-inventory:148:0: The f5 merge command owns its actual native child Path inventory through std::fs::ReadDir; propagate iteration failure before publishing a merged result.
rationale.root:host.environment-presence:220:0: The environment boundary uses std::env::var_os and explicit Unicode transport refusal; CLI arguments retain precedence, and credential bytes are never printed.
rationale.root:host.actual-browser-authority:241:0: TcpListener::local_addr already supplies the selected bound SocketAddr; its standard formatter handles IPv6 brackets and avoids using an unresolved input spelling.
